name: Gaming Database
description: Unlock instant gaming directly in your browser. Our extensive digital catalog bridges the gap between solitary adventures and community-driven action.

name: Browser Chess
description: Play professional online chess instantly. Challenge the powerful Stockfish engine as a guest with no login required, or log in to face players worldwide in multiplayer matchmaking, climb the ranks, and track your stats.

name: Terminal Snake
description: Classic snake in terminal style — keyboard, swipe or on-screen pad. Speeds up as you grow; your high score stays in your browser.

name: Breach Protocol
description: Hacking puzzle: pick codes along rows and columns to upload daemon sequences before your buffer runs out.
